in_hebrew.name: Adorne
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Man of Noble Birth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Adorne הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'adornos', meaning 'noble'. In Christian tradition, Adorne is believed to represent a person of high character and noble lineage.

in_greek.name: Adorne
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Man of Noble Birth
in_greek.long_meaning: Adorne είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'adornos', meaning 'noble'. In Christian tradition, Adorne is believed to represent a person of high character and noble lineage.

in_latin.name: Adorne
in_latin.meaning: Ornament, embellishment, or decoration; in Christian tradition, a name symbolizing spiritual beauty and inner adornment
in_latin.long_meaning: Ornamentem significat, ornamentum, aut decor, in traditione Christiana, nomen symbolizans pulchritudinem spiritualis et interiorem ornamentum; Adorne est nomen Christianum, quod significationem a nomine Hebraeo originalem accepit, et quae ornatum spiritualis et innerem significat, quae in traditione Christiana est importans; nomen Adorne est in usu a seculo XIV, et in traditione Christiana, in significationem ornamenti spiritualis et inneris, et non in significatum ornamenti externi.
